title: type=lmdb without [backend.lmdb] not caught at config validation
description: Both transit and reader validate type='kubo' requires [backend.kubo], but do not validate type='lmdb' requires [backend.lmdb]. If an operator writes [backend] type="lmdb" without a [backend.lmdb] subsection, lmdb field is None and startup code that unwraps it will panic. The Kubo precedent at transit/src/config.rs:524 should be repeated for Lmdb.
